summary: Full stack developer with 7+ years and 30+ production web projects, based in Bolivia and working remotely for a company in Panama. Main stack is TypeScript end to end: Angular (v9 to v19) with NGRX, RxJS, PrimeNG and Tailwind on the frontend; Node.js with Fastify or NestJS and Prisma over PostgreSQL on the backend. Recent React 19 and Next.js work. Independent contractor (freelance contracts are fine). AWS only at a conceptual level. English B1-B2 per CV; the profile uses B2, the optimistic reading. AI-assisted development and Anthropic SDK integration.
